the_shell.configuration.title: Example Mod Configs
tooltip.the_shell.air_bubble.details: Placed underwater, it creates an air pocket around it for about 3 minutes: you can breathe, your bottle refills, you mine at normal speed and see clearly. Then it pops.
tooltip.the_shell.air_vent.details: Underwater, an air vent pushes you up and quickly refills your diving suit's oxygen while you stand on it.
tooltip.the_shell.aqua_pearl.details: An ender pearl made for water: a normal pearl stops dead as soon as it hits water, this one flies underwater like in the air and falls slower. Throw it to teleport far away, even on the seafloor. Recipe: an ender pearl surrounded by 4 prismarine shards.
tooltip.the_shell.banana.details: Once eaten, you keep the peel. Bunches grow under banana tree leaves: right-click a yellow bunch to harvest it, and it grows back.
tooltip.the_shell.banana_peel.details: Drop it on the ground: whoever walks on it slips and lands on their back (press space to get up). Mobs too! Sneak to walk over it safely.
tooltip.the_shell.black_pearl.details: Dropped by the colossal squid of the abyss. Used to craft the grappling hook.
tooltip.the_shell.control_console.detail: In the submarine's cabin: right-click to see the battery, the submarine's height and the coordinates of the nearest rift.
tooltip.the_shell.crab_claw.reach: +10 reach for breaking and placing blocks
tooltip.the_shell.diving_abyss_helmet.de: A diving helmet with its own light: you see further in the darkness of the abyss. It also does everything the diving helmet does.
tooltip.the_shell.diving_boots.details: Weighted with an iron ingot, they make you sink so you can walk on the seafloor. Press G underwater to drop the weight and rise. Also a diving suit piece against pressure.
tooltip.the_shell.diving_boots.light: Not weighted: right-click it with an iron ingot to weigh it down
tooltip.the_shell.diving_boots.weighted: Weighted: you sink. Press G underwater to drop the ingot
tooltip.the_shell.diving_chestplate.deta: Diving suit piece: each piece you wear reduces the effect of deep pressure. All 4 together protect you completely.
tooltip.the_shell.diving_helmet.details: Underwater, you breathe the suit's oxygen. Shows the oxygen and pressure gauges. Each piece of the suit reduces the pressure, and all 4 together protect you completely.
tooltip.the_shell.diving_leggings.detail: Diving suit piece: each piece you wear reduces the effect of deep pressure. All 4 together protect you completely.
tooltip.the_shell.grappling_hook.details: Aim at a block up to 32 blocks away and hold right-click: the hook pulls you to it, even underwater.
tooltip.the_shell.kyber_axe.details: An energy-bladed axe built with the same technology as the lightsabers. Right-click to switch it on or off. When on, it fells a whole tree in one go. Shift + right-click turns it into a sickle.
tooltip.the_shell.kyber_crystal.details: A rare, energy-filled crystal from the abyss. A single one fully recharges the submarine's battery. It is also used to craft the pocket sonar, the air bubble and the lightsabers.
tooltip.the_shell.kyber_sickle.details: The kyber axe in its sickle form: it is the same item, with the same durability. Shift + right-click turns it back into the axe.
tooltip.the_shell.lightsaber.change_mode: Shift + Right Click: change lightsaber mode
tooltip.the_shell.lightsaber.recharge: Durability 4000, cannot be repaired. Right-click it in the inventory with a kyber crystal: +750.
tooltip.the_shell.machine.details: The submarine's engine, in its cabin: right-click with coal, redstone or kyber to recharge the battery without going outside.
tooltip.the_shell.notch_altar.details: Right-click: Notch asks you a Minecraft question in the chat. Answer by typing in the chat (others don't see your answer). Right answer: the altar lights up and the seals of its level open. In creative, sneak + right-click changes the level (1 easy, 2 medium, 3 hard).
tooltip.the_shell.oxygen_bottle.details: 4 one-minute charges of oxygen for the diving suit. Right-click to use one. Refills completely at a tank.
tooltip.the_shell.pocket_sonar.details: Right-click: a ping makes nearby creatures glow through walls, and reveals ores and chests for 8 seconds.
tooltip.the_shell.submarine.details: Place it in water. Right-click: take the controls (hold Ctrl to look around without turning). The yellow button on the small console to the right of the seat takes you down to the cabin, bigger on the inside. Recharge the battery with coal, redstone or kyber. Hit it while sneaking to pick it up: it keeps its upgrades, battery and cabin.
tooltip.the_shell.submarine_upgrade_diam: Right-click a submarine that already has the iron upgrade. Adds a second room to the cabin and more speed.
tooltip.the_shell.submarine_upgrade_iron: Right-click a submarine to upgrade it. Kits go in order: iron, diamond, then netherite. This one adds a room to the cabin and a bit of speed.
tooltip.the_shell.submarine_upgrade_neth: Right-click a submarine that already has the diamond upgrade. Adds a third room, more speed, and a sonar that shows the direction and distance of the nearest rift from the cockpit.
tooltip.the_shell.tank.details: Tank: right-click to fully refill your diving suit's oxygen, and the oxygen bottle in your hand. Works anywhere, place one near your base.
tooltip.the_shell.temple_pedestal.detail: The item on it floats and spins. Right-click with an item to put it on, right-click empty-handed to take it back. Taking the item sends a redstone pulse, like a trapped chest... Careful in the temple. Recipe: a gold ingot on stone bricks.
tooltip.the_shell.temple_seal.details: An indestructible door. It disappears (along with every seal touching it) when the Notch altar of the same level is solved, or when it gets a redstone signal. In creative, sneak + right-click changes its level (0 = redstone only).
